description: A comprehensive subtitle correction module implementing language-agnostic alignment, timestamp correction, missing cue generation, OTT constraints enforcement, and optional audio-based disambiguation. The code covers normalization utilities, transcript and cue processing, similarity scoring, flexible window search for alignment, cue correction with semantic and fuzzy matching, OTT timing constraints enforcement, and hub functions for explicit subtitle correction workflows with optional audio embedding comparisons.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(text: str)
methods.description: Unicode-aware normalization; collapses whitespace, strips leading/trailing whitespace.

methods.name: float _safe_float(x: Any, default: float = 0.0)
methods.description: Safely convert input to float with default fallback.

methods.name: str _s_to_srt_time(seconds: float)
methods.description: Converts seconds to SRT timestamp format HH:MM:SS,mmm.

methods.name: Optional[str] _normalize_lang_code(value: Optional[str])
methods.description: Normalizes language code strings to lowercase, 2-5 letter tokens.

methods.name: bool _likely_same_language(transcript: Dict[str, Any], subtitles: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Determines whether transcript and subtitles are likely in the same language, using explicit keys and script heuristics.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _flatten_transcript_segments(transcript: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Transforms a transcript dict into a list of segments with start/end in seconds and normalized text.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _normalize_subtitle_cues(subtitles: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Standardizes subtitle cues, accepting start/end in seconds or ms, normalizing text.

methods.name: str _normalize_core_for_compare(core: str)

methods.name: float _sequence_similarity(a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Calculates normalized similarity ratio between strings using difflib.SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: Tuple[str,float] _best_fuzzy_match(word: str, candidates: List[str])
methods.description: Finds candidate word with the best fuzzy sequence similarity.

methods.name: bool _synonym_or_same(a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Checks if two core words are synonyms or identical after normalization.

methods.name: float _token_overlap_ratio(a_tokens: List[str], b_tokens: List[str])

methods.description: Splits a token into leading punctuation, core, trailing punctuation.

methods.name: float _overlap_s(a_start: float, a_end: float, b_start: float, b_end: float)
methods.description: Calculates the intersection duration between two time spans.

methods.name: float _jaccard_similarity(tokens_a: List[str], tokens_b: List[str])
methods.description: Calculates token set Jaccard similarity.

methods.name: str _apply_case_like(source: str, target_style: str)
methods.description: Applies case style of target string to source string.

methods.name: List[str] _normalize_tokens_cores(text: str)

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _max_contiguous_token_run(cue_cores: List[str], win_cores: List[str])
methods.description: Finds the longest contiguous run of synonym-equal tokens between cue and window cores.
